title: Private lessons with Edwin Hogan
summary: He took lessons in Hogan's studio on LaSalle Street; Hogan was a gifted teacher and his brother Wilbert played drums.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: I weren't there in the daytime, so I can't say we went on in the day. But at night they had, Professor Hogan, he was teaching, that's how I got to meet him. That's how I got to take private lessons after I left from school, because I used to go to his studio back on LaSalle Street.

Okay. Edwin Hogan, yeah. Edwin Hogan. And he was almost like a little genius as far as I was concerned. I mean he could play and sing. He had a group that used to sing under the stars over there in a square out there. He always kept something going. He won all kind of awards for his brother. He played drums.
Oh, I know he played with Joe Jones' band, Wilbert Hogan.
